name: First Project Post Mortem
trigger: A brand new to Build has its first project marked Complete in Portal.
purpose: A 15-minute sync between the Account Manager and the Sales Rep who closed the deal, held after a new brand's first project completes, to close the loop between what was sold and what got delivered while it is fresh. Fires only for the first project from a new brand.
doneWhen: The four questions have been answered, follow-ups routed, and the post-mortem logged in the First-Project Post-Mortem Logs database.

steps.title: Is this the brand's first project with Build?
steps.trigger: A project reaches Complete in Portal.
steps.work: Only the first project from a new brand triggers the post-mortem. Repeat projects from the same brand do not.

steps.title: Schedule the 15-minute sync with the Sales Rep
steps.trigger: A new brand's first project is Complete.
steps.work: Grab 15 minutes on the Sales Rep's calendar within a few days of completion. Don't wait for them to come to you. Quick, focused, no deck.
steps.when: Within a few days of completion

steps.title: Run the four questions
steps.work: 1. How'd it go? Smooth or fire drills; what the rep should know about working with this brand. 2. Is the customer happy? Signals, not guesses: direct feedback, tone, willingness to commit to project #2. 3. How were the NOs? Friction, missed SLAs, communication gaps. 4. What does the P&L look like and were the quoted rates clear and accurate in execution?

steps.title: What did the answers surface?
steps.work: Route each finding to the right follow-up. Everything went well still gets captured, especially anything reusable for similar brands.

steps.title: Flag to the Sales Rep and leadership immediately
steps.trigger: The customer is unhappy or at risk.
steps.work: Flag it to the Sales Rep and leadership now. Don't wait for the next QBR.

steps.title: Log NO friction against the brand
steps.work: Log it against the brand so it informs NO assignment on project #2.

steps.title: Loop in pricing and Ops before the next quote
steps.trigger: Margin missed or the quoted rates were ambiguous in execution.
steps.work: Loop in pricing and Ops before the next quote goes out so the next SOW is tighter.

steps.title: Log the post-mortem
steps.work: Log it in the First-Project Post-Mortem Logs database. The four questions are pre-filled via the template button; drop the Granola URL in the property at the top.
